title: Final Answer Bounds
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct lower and upper bounds for the elastic cross section in terms of the inelastic cross section.

title: Correct Formulas
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the formulas for the elastic and inelastic cross sections.

title: Use of Parameters
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly incorporate the parameters eta_l and delta_l in their derivation.

title: Logical Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate a clear logical progression in deriving the bounds from the given equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the cross sections are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the modulus in complex numbers.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the implications of the bounds when eta_l approaches its limits (0 or 1).
